facts.text: Serve the mains when the Duke rolls up in his chandelier car.
facts.why: The Duke's Cadillac with the chandeliers is real, but the sources I opened do not say when it first rolls up. Wikipedia's plot only has the Duke and his followers confronting Snake at street level, then giving chase.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when the Duke and his followers confront Snake in the street.

facts.why: Wikipedia says Brain built a gasoline refinery. No source I opened shows him making moonshine.
facts.fix: Brain runs the island's gasoline, so he probably runs the still

vibe.verdict: The USPF mess hall idea and the map are excellent, but the dishes are plain army food and the film's best bits are barely used.
missing: The Bandstand Boogie cassette (Cabbie's tape and the ending)
Chock Full o'Nuts (where Snake takes refuge)
The 23 hour clock on the neck charges (Hauk's deal)
Snake against Slag in the ring (the Duke's fight)
ideas: Swap the 'Coffee' description 'Bottomless all night' for 'Chock Full o'Nuts, bottomless all night'.
Swap 'Tins and Saltines' for 'Cabbie's Bandstand Boogie Special' and a cassette stamp.
Add a countdown line to the mess pass in place of 'NO. 1988-022': 'Charges dissolve in 23 hours'.
Swap 'Grilled Cheese' for 'Snake's Name Is Snake Sandwich', ordered with a growl.
